mechanistic_edges.subject: CHEBI:16240
mechanistic_edges.description: The 1993 abstract reports in-vitro inactivation of purified native JJ1b protocatechuate 2,3-dioxygenase by hydrogen peroxide among Fe2+-oxidizing reagents. This is an assay perturbation of the historical native preparation, not physiological regulation or a 2009 recombinant-sequence claim. No dose or exact damaged-site occupancy is asserted.

mechanistic_edges.subject: CHEBI:22651
mechanistic_edges.description: Ascorbate restores activity to the historical purified native enzyme after oxidative inactivation, including the reported hydrogen peroxide treatment. The abstract attributes recovery to reduction of the iron. This edge claims recovery of the qualified inactive preparation, not stimulation of untreated enzyme; stereochemistry of the ascorbate reagent is not specified.

No baseline activation, physiological control, damage-site assignment, metal occupancy or sequence identity to2009 C4TP01 is inferred.
